subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should permanent Telegram topic deletion be exposed by the message tool, and if so must it use a distinct default-off action and configuration gate from create/edit/close/reopen?
rationale: Telegram deletion irreversibly removes every message in the topic and uses a stronger administrator permission than the reversible lifecycle methods, so action naming and default exposure require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Split destructive deletion
options.body: Add close and reopen normally, while placing `topic-delete` behind its own explicit default-off gate and documentation.

options.title: Exclude permanent deletion
options.body: Implement create, edit, close, and reopen but leave deletion outside the agent-facing message tool.

options.title: Enable the full lifecycle
options.body: Expose all lifecycle actions by default and rely on Telegram administrator permissions as the only guard.

recommendation.title: Split destructive deletion
recommendation.body: Add close and reopen normally, while placing `topic-delete` behind its own explicit default-off gate and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent detailed review already framed the exact permission and product boundary that needs resolution.
